images/cat-portrait.jpg.title: Cat portrait
images/cat-portrait.jpg.author: Roy Tanck
images/cat-portrait.jpg.usage: 真实照片用作自然场景的视觉参考和采样示意输入；模拟响应由图像区域平均值生成，不是实际传感器测量。

assets/digital-image-cat-scene.png.title: 暖光桌面猫咪场景
assets/digital-image-cat-scene.png.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Input image is a REFERENCE for the left-hand photographic scene ONLY, not an edit target for UI. Generate one new clean photographic asset matching the left photo's subject and mood: a fluffy brown tabby kitten with white chest and paws sitting on a sunlit wooden desk, facing slightly right, eyes looking up; warm window daylight from the right; blurred green potted plant, cream desk lamp in the upper left, subtle white mug at the far left, cozy room. Portrait 4:5 composition, kitten full head and front paws visible, eyes near the upper middle. The fur and eye should have warm amber, brown, black and green color details suitable for pixel magnification. Natural photographic realism. Deliver ONLY the photograph filling the image, no page, no text, no grid, no arrows, no diagrams, no UI, no white borders. Preserve rich original photo detail; all educational overlays will be added in code.
assets/digital-image-cat-scene.png.usage: 第二页场景图与像素采样的共同输入；像素网格、RGB 数值和数字表由浏览器实时生成。

assets/digital-image-cat-cutout.png.title: 猫咪透明前景
assets/digital-image-cat-cutout.png.prompt: Remove the entire background leaving only the kitten on genuine transparency; preserve pose, colors, paws, ears and whiskers. No checkerboard or text.
assets/digital-image-cat-cutout.png.usage: 第五页四种像素表示共用的前景，浏览器保留透明边缘并把接近完全不透明的主体 Alpha 归为 255；前三列合成到固定浅色背景，RGBA 保留透明通道并允许调整整体不透明度。

assets/color-space-macaw.png.title: 蓝黄金刚鹦鹉
assets/color-space-macaw.png.prompt: Natural close-up blue-and-yellow macaw on a branch against blurred green tropical foliage; rich blue, yellow and green, landscape 4:3, no text or UI.
assets/color-space-macaw.png.usage: 颜色空间页同一原图的实时通道转换与调节输入

assets/arithmetic-table-background.png.title: 图像算术空桌面背景
assets/arithmetic-table-background.png.prompt: Landscape empty wooden tabletop with plant and mug at far left, neutral wall, soft daylight, no cat or UI.
assets/arithmetic-table-background.png.usage: 唯一新增背景照片素材。背景与黑底猫咪分别预留灰度范围后逐像素相加，减法反向还原背景；区域掩膜、融合与乘除结果均由真实数组运算得到。

assets/roi-fruit-background.png.title: 掩膜演示水果背景
assets/roi-fruit-background.png.prompt: Ceramic fruit bowl with oranges left, banana back, green grapes right, clear center gap, no apple, warm daylight.
assets/roi-fruit-background.png.usage: 作为未处理背景，独立透明苹果由Canvas合成；处理结果逐像素计算。

assets/roi-apple-cutout.png.title: 掩膜演示透明苹果
assets/roi-apple-cutout.png.prompt: One red speckled apple with stem, frontal slightly top-down view, soft upper-left light, transparent background.
assets/roi-apple-cutout.png.usage: 透明苹果合成到背景，从alpha阈值生成二值Mask与ROI外接矩形。

assets/binarization-metal-tokens.png.title: 二值化金属圆片与垫圈素材
assets/binarization-metal-tokens.png.prompt: Top-down square grayscale photograph of exactly five separated dark metal objects: three engraved tokens and two washers, visibly different diameters, loose asymmetric arrangement, generous spacing and margins on pale gray paper, diffuse light, subtle contact shadows, no UI, text or currency branding.
assets/binarization-metal-tokens.png.usage: 二值化与大津法共用的灰度输入照片：三个圆片、两个垫圈，大小不同且间距较大。全部二值结果、直方图、占比及Otsu阈值由像素数组实际计算。

assets/otsu-mechanical-parts.png.title: Otsu灰底零件素材
assets/otsu-mechanical-parts.png.prompt: Square grayscale top-down photo of five separated dark matte mechanical parts on medium gray paper, diffuse light, subtle shadows, no labels or UI.
assets/otsu-mechanical-parts.png.usage: Otsu可切换灰度输入；直方图、类间方差和二值结果按实际像素计算。

assets/otsu-document.png.title: Otsu文档素材

assets/otsu-document.png.usage: 文档阈值演示输入；切换保留旧阈值，点击重新计算才应用新Otsu阈值。
